title: DbDataBuild model test file
description: A model test file (tests/models/<name>.yml): cases of given rows and what the model's query must return for them, run in an in-memory DuckDB. The file's name is the test and, unless `model` says otherwise, the model it tests. Severity, tags and description are `#` comments at the top of the file, not keys. Values are read as text and cast by DuckDB to the column's declared type; a plain null or empty value is NULL. This schema is for editors; `dbdatabuild project validate` applies the same rules plus the semantic ones (the tables and columns given exist).

model.description: The model this file tests, when it is not the one the file's path names.

cases.description: At least one case. A case needs `expect`, `assert`, or both.

given.description: Rows for each table the model's query reads, by table name. A column left out of a row is NULL; a table not given is empty.

expect.description: The rows the query must return, as a list, or as a mapping with `rows` and `ordered: true` when the order matters. Duplicates count.

ordered.description: The rows must come back in this order.

assert.description: A single SELECT over the table `result` that returns the violating rows; no rows means the case passes.

items.description: One row: column name to value.
